title.narrative: Process consultant of the Danish Peace and Stabilisation Programme West Africa (PSP WA) 2025-2028

description.narrative: Assistance to the Embassy in Accra Ghana to ensure systematic and compliant initiation of the Danish Peace and Stabilisation Programme for West Africa 2025 - 2028

The Process consultant will assist the Embassy with the significant effort required during the start-up phase due to the challenges of several component project documents are either still under preparation or yet to be developed. A Call for Proposal (CfP) for project(s) must be conducted; a tender process for the MEAL contract needs to be organised; agreements with all cooperation partners need to be formalised; a new project management team, comprising representatives from the Embassy, the National Police, and the Ministry of Defence, needs to be established. In addition, a new regional network with partners, donors, and authorities must be created to facilitate collaboration and coordination.
